<style id="nk-mobile-klaster-fix-20260913">
@media(max-width:850px){
  main.article-shell.wrap{display:block!important;width:min(calc(100% - 24px),820px)!important;max-width:820px!important;padding:18px 0 44px!important}
  main.article-shell article.article{display:block!important;width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;overflow:visible!important}
  main.article-shell article.article>.tag{display:none!important}
  main.article-shell article.article>.hero{display:block!important;grid-template-columns:none!important;gap:0!important;width:100%!important;max-width:none!important;margin:0!important;padding:0 0 16px!important}
  main.article-shell article.article>.hero>.eyebrow{display:block!important;position:static!important;float:none!important;clear:both!important;width:100%!important;margin:0 0 10px!important;padding:0!important;color:#a9232b!important;font:800 12px/1.45 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif!important;letter-spacing:.08em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;white-space:normal!important}
  main.article-shell article.article>.hero>h1{display:block!important;position:static!important;float:none!important;clear:both!important;width:100%!important;max-width:none!important;margin:0 0 16px!important;padding:0!important;font:800 30px/1.07 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif!important;letter-spacing:-.025em!important;overflow-wrap:normal!important;word-break:normal!important;hyphens:auto!important;text-indent:0!important}
  main.article-shell article.article>.hero>.perex{display:block!important;position:static!important;float:none!important;clear:both!important;width:100%!important;max-width:none!important;margin:0 0 15px!important;padding:0!important;font-size:17px!important;line-height:1.55!important;text-indent:0!important}
  main.article-shell article.article>.hero>.meta{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;gap:4px 8px!important;font-size:11px!important;line-height:1.5!important}
  main.article-shell article.article>.hero>.rule{margin-top:16px!important}
  main.article-shell article.article>.article-figure{width:100%!important;margin:2px 0 26px!important;padding:0!important}
  main.article-shell article.article>.article-figure img{display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:auto!important}
  main.article-shell article.article>.featured-cleaning-ad,
  main.article-shell article.article>.featured-rotating-ad{width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;margin:26px 0 30px!important;overflow:hidden!important;position:relative!important;left:auto!important;right:auto!important}
  header[data-site-header="v1"] .head:not(:has(.menu-toggle)) nav{display:none!important}
}
</style>
</head>

<script id="nk-mobile-klaster-adfix-20260913">
(function(){
  function fix(){
    var article=document.querySelector('main.article-shell article.article')||document.querySelector('main article');
    if(!article)return false;
    var ad=article.querySelector('.featured-cleaning-ad,.featured-rotating-ad');
    var target=article.querySelector('.article-figure')||article.querySelector('.hero .perex');
    if(ad&&target&&ad.previousElementSibling!==target){
      target.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',ad);
      return true;
    }
    return !!ad;
  }
  function start(){
    var article=document.querySelector('main.article-shell article.article')||document.querySelector('main article');
    if(!article)return;
    fix();
    var observer=new MutationObserver(function(){
      if(fix())setTimeout(function(){observer.disconnect()},1200);
    });
    observer.observe(article,{childList:true,subtree:true});
    setTimeout(fix,50);setTimeout(fix,250);setTimeout(fix,800);setTimeout(fix,1600);
    setTimeout(function(){observer.disconnect()},4000);
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',start,{once:true});else start();
})();
</script>
</body>
